answer.conclusion: Ferret's verdict is computed by the pure `verifyAnchors` in `src/context/code-state.ts`, shared by the trust surface and the context pack. It compares the *indexed* content hash captured for each anchored path when the statement was recorded against the indexed hash for that path now, gated on a live-tree correspondence check. `verified` requires all of: not superseded, active lifecycle, at least one anchored observation, correspondence established (live HEAD of the checked-out branch equals the single indexed head for that branch), and one whole observation whose every anchor resolves, is not withheld by exclusion/permission, is not in the `git status` dirty sample, with an untruncated sample, and whose hashes are byte-identical. Anything short of that is reported as `superseded`, `unanchored`, `unknown` with a category-only reason, or — only when correspondence holds and every anchor was readable but a hash differs — `stale`, which is explicitly "needs re-verification", not "false".
key_facts: `verifyAnchors` (src/context/code-state.ts:157-215) checks lifecycle first: `supersededBy` set or lifecycle SUPERSEDED → `superseded`; any other historical lifecycle state, or zero anchored observations → `unanchored`.

`verified` is returned only if `correspondence.established` is true and some observation has ≥1 anchor report, no report carrying a `reason`, and every report `matches` (src/context/code-state.ts:175-188). Any observation may satisfy it; otherwise the newest observation's reports are what gets reported.

An anchor report `matches` only when the map entry exists, is not withheld, holds a hash, and that hash equals the recorded `observedHash`; absent/withheld/hashless are ANCHOR_UNRESOLVED, never 'unchanged' (src/context/code-state.ts:217-230).

Fallback order when nothing verified: correspondence not established → `unknown` with its reason (default index-does-not-correspond); else a blocked anchor's reason → `unknown`; else → `stale` (src/context/code-state.ts:195-214).

UnknownReason vocabulary: repository-not-indexed, index-does-not-correspond, anchored-path-modified, working-tree-sample-truncated, anchor-does-not-resolve, anchor-excluded-by-rule, anchor-not-permitted, scope-not-locally-readable — category only, never a path (src/context/code-state.ts:27-45).

`CodeStateStore.currentContent` marks a path PATH_DIRTY if it is in `correspondence.dirtyPaths`, and DIRT_UNKNOWN if the working-tree sample was truncated; exclusion maps to EXCLUDED and scope/permission to NOT_PERMITTED via the same `withholds` policy retrieval uses (src/storage/code-state.ts:122-161, 39-50).

Correspondence is established by comparing the live `git status --porcelain=v2 --branch` HEAD and *checked-out* branch against the single indexed head for that branch name; detached HEAD, an unindexed branch, or two disagreeing index rows all return unestablished (src/storage/code-state.ts:177-268; src/git/worktree-state.ts:74-86).

The checkout evaluated is resolved from indexed worktree entities matched against the caller's cwd (`process.cwd()` at the MCP composition root); several worktrees with no cwd match resolve to nothing and the verdict is `unknown` (src/storage/code-state.ts:219-246; src/cli/commands/mcp.ts:83-100).

The hash on both sides comes from the newest open FILE_HAS_VERSION edge, not the only one — a changed file keeps a stale open edge; contents are not re-hashed from disk at verify time (src/storage/code-state.ts:291-310).

Correspondence is never cached across calls (a per-instance memo would keep reporting `verified` against the head the server process first saw); it is memoised only within one find/pack call because `git status` is ~120ms against a 200-statement page (src/storage/code-state.ts:163-175; src/storage/durable-context.ts:543-552; src/context/pack.ts:441-457).
The dirty-path sample is capped at MAX_SAMPLED_PATHS = 50, and `sampleTruncated` above that is what drives working-tree-sample-truncated (src/git/worktree-state.ts:17, 198).

`ferret_context_trust` omits `verification` entirely when no code-state reader is wired, deliberately distinguishing 'Ferret cannot answer' from 'nothing was claimed' (src/storage/durable-context.ts:508-514).
